- GMs receive one notice when installed modules require a newer GlitchSmith Library, including modules disabled because of the version mismatch.

announcement.title: 📚 GlitchSmith Library v0.13.1
announcement.content:
GlitchSmith Library v0.13.1 fixes custom-calendar time handling and adds minimum-version guidance.

  • When a world opens, GMs see the installed library version, each affected module's minimum requirement, and update instructions. The check includes modules disabled by a version mismatch and works offline.
  • The shared clock reads custom time units from Simple Calendar, Simple Calendar Reborn, Calendaria, Seasons & Stars, and Foundry calendars, including calendars used by Simple Timekeeping. External calendars keep those units when read through Smartphone Widget.
  • Clock subscribers refresh when supported calendars are edited or switched, including Simple Calendar changes received from another GM.
  • Duration and remaining-time calculations use the active calendar's time units.
